name: Machine Seated Cable Row
cardText:
1
Sit with your back straight on the machine and grip the handles.
2
Pull the handles back using your arms. Your legs and torso should be at a 90° angle. Push out your chest.
3
Pull the handles towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.

name: Machine Bicep Curl
cardText:
1
Adjust the seat to fit your height and place your elbows on the elbow pad.
2
Grab the handles and flex your elbows.

name: Machine Seated Plate Loaded Preacher Curl
cardText:
1
Sit at the bench and rest the back of your arms on the preacher bench.
2
Grab the handles. Curl the weight up until your elbows are fully flexed.
3
Lower until the point just before the weight rests at the bottom.

name: Machine Standing Plate Loaded Preacher Curl
cardText:
1

2
Grab the handles. Curl the weight up until your elbows are fully flexed.
3
Lower until the point just before the weight rests at the bottom.

name: Machine Assisted Pull Up
cardText:
1
Adjust weight for assistance. Stand on platform, grip handles above shoulder-width. Knees on pad if available.
2
Slowly pull up until chin is above the bar. Keep elbows close, core engaged.
3
Lower back with control. Pause at bottom. Repeat for reps.

name: Machine Underhand Row
cardText:
1
Sit on the machine, feet flat, and grab the handles with palms facing up, keeping your back straight.
2
Pull handles towards your lower abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep elbows close to your body.
3
Slowly return to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking elbows. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Pulldown
cardText:
1
Grip the handles with the palms facing down.
2
Sit on the machine and press your knees into the knee pad.
3
Pull the handles until your upper arm is even with your torso, or just behind your torso.
4
Extend until your elbows are fully extended before initiating the next rep.
